stories.title: Moses Recalls the Wilderness Years
stories.summary: On the plains of Moab Moses recounts the departure from Horeb, the spies, the forty years, and the conquests of Sihon and Og. He pleads to enter the land and is told to commission Joshua instead.

stories.title: Call to Obey the Law
stories.summary: Moses urges Israel to keep the statutes, warns against making images, and points to Horeb as the event no other nation has witnessed. He sets apart three cities of refuge east of the Jordan.

stories.title: The Ten Commandments and the Shema
stories.summary: Moses restates the Ten Commandments given at Horeb, then commands Israel to love the LORD with heart, soul and might and to teach the words to their children.

stories.title: Driving Out the Nations
stories.summary: Israel is told to destroy the nations of Canaan and avoid their gods, to remember God's provision in the wilderness, and not to credit its own righteousness. Moses recalls the golden calf and his intercession.

stories.title: The Second Tablets and the Choice
stories.summary: Moses recalls the second tablets and the ark, calls Israel to fear and love God, and sets before them blessing on Gerizim and curse on Ebal.

stories.title: Laws for Life in the Land
stories.summary: Moses gives rules for one place of worship, clean food, tithes, the release of debts, festivals, judges, kings, prophets, war, family life and justice, ending with firstfruits and tithing declarations.

stories.title: Blessings and Curses of the Covenant
stories.summary: Israel is told to write the law on stones at Mount Ebal and recite curses and blessings. Long lists of blessings for obedience and curses for disobedience follow, ending in exile.

stories.title: Renewal of the Covenant in Moab
stories.summary: Moses renews the covenant with all Israel and warns of scattering for unfaithfulness, then promises restoration. He sets before them life and death and urges them to choose life.

stories.title: Joshua Commissioned and the Song of Moses
stories.summary: Moses, aged 120, hands leadership to Joshua and gives the law to the priests. God gives him a witness song recounting Israel's unfaithfulness, and tells him to climb Mount Nebo to see the land.

stories.title: Moses Blesses the Tribes and Dies
stories.summary: Moses blesses each tribe, then climbs Nebo, sees the land, and dies at 120 in Moab. Israel mourns thirty days and Joshua takes over.
